items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I was teaching Sylvia jazz, you know? And blues.

ctx.x: No. He was just...he was a thorough musician. Just a thorough musician and wasn't to be played with. And he wasn't to be, you know...he was ready to go to the war in a minute.

This is sort of an off beat thing that I was looking through. We have some clippings at the Institute, you know, in our files and in one of them I saw an item which may have been just a press agent's item, but there might be something to it. You were teaching Sylvia Marlowe to play...
Yeah. She played the harpsichord and I was teaching Sylvia jazz, you know? And blues. She knew the fundamentals... Teaching...I'm not sure whether it's teaching or instructing.
